selectedDefects.pullRequestTitle: Fix enabled state of controls in Syncing preferences panel
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: git ls-tree lists Vienna.xcodeproj, Vienna/ and Vienna Tests; Vienna/Sources/Preferences window/SyncingPreferencesViewController.m is Objective-C AppKit with IBOutlet NSTextField, NSSecureTextField and NSButton, driven by Vienna/Resources/Interfaces/Base.lproj/Preferences.storyboard. The fix commit 7ae4808 is the merge of pull request 2054 and its first parent, the affected revision, is mainline immediately before the merge; the substantive commit inside the branch is 9b23c67f320b290bce71dd794d6c0c4f22f25c05

accessibilityReachability.trigger: open Preferences and select the Syncing pane with the sync checkbox off, which is the default; optionally AXPress the sync AXCheckBox and re-read the pane
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXEnabled across the sibling controls: the source AXPopUpButton is enabled at the affected revision and disabled at the fixed revision, while the sibling AXTextField controls are correctly disabled in both
accessibilityReachability.note: at the affected revision viewWillAppear disables the source, host, username and password controls when sync is off and then unconditionally re-enables the popup on its last line; the fix removes that line and binds enablement through Cocoa bindings

signing.evidence: Vienna/Codesigning.xcconfig sets CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = Apple Development, which must be overridden to ad-hoc, and ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME is on, but Vienna/Vienna.entitlements has no sandbox key and requests only AppleEvents automation, app-scope bookmarks and Sparkle mach-lookup exceptions, so no paid Developer ID is required

selectedDefects.whySuitable: this is the only verified candidate whose whole signal is an AXEnabled read across a set of sibling controls rather than a single element, so it exercises accessibility subtree traversal, and it does so on an Objective-C, storyboard and Cocoa bindings stack rather than SwiftUI, which widens what the adapter is proven against
selectedDefects.caveat: there is no linked issue for this fix, only the pull request, so issueUrl and issueTitle are null rather than invented
remaining: build both revisions with the signing identity overridden to ad-hoc
block the network so the first-launch demo feed refresh and the Sparkle check stay inert, and record that as containment
state identity and authority, and minimize the trigger
run three affected reproductions and three fixed controls with reset evidence, resetting the preferences domain between runs
record neighboring legal behavior: the sibling text fields must be disabled on both builds

reserveCandidates.issueTitle: Text Encoding disappeared from the Status Bar
reserveCandidates.reason: both revisions verified and the ad-hoc signing configuration is present. A two-line fix in the status bar, observable as an empty versus populated AXValue. Held in reserve because it is the same observable shape as the counts candidate

reserveCandidates.issueTitle: Filename on toolbar remains "Untitled" after creating new file with custom name from sidebar
reserveCandidates.reason: both revisions verified, but the fix targets NSWindow.subtitle and it is not confirmed without running whether the subtitle is exposed as the window AXTitle or as a separate title bar AXStaticText. Promote only after an accessibility tree dump of a built application

rejectedCandidates.reason: the issue and both revisions are real, but reading app/sources/BaseDataDocument.m at the affected revision shows showViewForRepresenter: touches rep.view before addRepresenter:, so inside HexFiend.app the placeholder string is written while the controller is nil and is immediately overwritten. The symptom manifests only in third-party embedders of the framework, so it is not drivable through this application's accessibility tree
